text:
Marta (fin): Morning team — noticed a ~$13.2k unexpected line on the APAC invoice for GPU-SKU-XL. Usage attribution looks normal but vendor rate multiplier spiked between 2026-03-25T22:00 and 2026-03-26T02:00. Need plan for allocation and temporary bookkeeping.
BillingBot: ALERT: vendor_rate_anomaly region=apac sku=GPU-SKU-XL extra_cost=13200 window=2026-03-25T22:00Z-2026-03-26T02:00Z export=s3://billing/exports/2026-03-26/apac-rate-anom.csv
Ilya (platform): Vendor acknowledged misapplied promo and issued a credit ticket (VND-2026-APAC-88) ETA 8 business days. Platform can cover up to $6k from reserve this cycle.
Tanvi (ml): ML teams consumed ~5.8k of the affected GPU-hrs. Product demos used ~900 GPU-hrs. If we bill teams now some will hit monthly alerts.
Marta (fin): Two short options: 1) Provisional amortization across impacted teams (proportional by GPU-hrs) to avoid invoice noise; reverse when vendor credit posts. 2) Platform covers full delta until vendor credit. Need approvals and an audit trail.
Victor (product): Product prefers smoothing — demos shouldn't be interrupted for customers. Provisional amortization with prompt reversal is OK if teams get notified.
Ilya (platform): I approve up to $6k platform cover. For the remainder, finance can create provisional amortized charges. Platform will expedite vendor follow-up.
Tanvi (ml): Fine with amortization. Can you post the team breakout so leads can sign off quickly?
Marta (fin): Posting provisional spreadsheet now: s3://finance/adj/2026-03-26/provisional-apac-amort.csv. Columns: team, gpu_hrs, provisional_amount, contact, reason. SQL used to generate breakdown: 

SELECT team, SUM(gpu_hours) as gpu_hrs, ROUND(SUM(gpu_hours)/X * extra_cost,2) as provisional_amount 
FROM billing_usage WHERE sku='GPU-SKU-XL' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-25T22:00' AND '2026-03-26T02:00' GROUP BY team;

Marta (fin): Action items: 1) Ilya approve platform cover (done up to $6k). 2) Team leads to ack provisional amounts in the spreadsheet by EOD. 3) Finance will post provisional INT records so accounting shows the temporary entries. 4) When vendor credit posts, finance will reverse provisional entries and issue refunds/credit notes.
Ilya (platform): Opening vendor escalation ticket VND-2026-APAC-88 and requesting faster credit. Also adding infra guardrail to alert on sudden multiplier changes.
Tanvi (ml): Notifying ML leads now. We accept provisional charge pending reversal. Uploading confirmation: s3://ml-logs/2026-03-26/ml-leads-ack.csv
Victor (product): Product demos ok. Please exclude any customer-billed demo runs from the provisional charge; Ilya/ops please flag them.
Marta (fin): Exclusions applied per Victor's note. Updated spreadsheet: s3://finance/adj/2026-03-26/provisional-apac-amort-updated.csv. Draft INT entries created: INT-2026-03670-PROV.
BillingBot: NOTE: provisional_entries_posted INT-2026-03670-PROV. Vendor ticket VND-2026-APAC-88 linked.
Marta (fin): Thanks all. Closing thread after vendor credit posts and reversals complete. We'll keep accounting in the loop. :white_check_mark:
